title: Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident Hardware manufacturer Trezor has said it is checking which vendors it works with following reports of lost funds from Ledger models. This post Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
